title: Inpatient, Skilled Nursing and Procedure Cost Share Under the Ridgecrest Advantage Plans
content:
Cost share on facility stays and on the procedure categories priced by coinsurance is fixed by the Ridgecrest Advantage Medicare Advantage Health Plan the member holds. Per-day figures are copays in USD for each day of the stay; coinsurance figures are percentages of the plan allowed amount.

| Plan | Acute inpatient, days 1 to 6 (USD per day) | Acute inpatient, day 7 onward (USD per day) | Skilled nursing, days 1 to 20 (USD per day) | Skilled nursing, days 21 to 100 (USD per day) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Value (HMO) | 350 | 0 | 0 | 196 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Essential (HMO) | 325 | 0 | 0 | 203 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Plus (HMO-POS) | 295 | 0 | 0 | 214 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Premier (PPO) | 375 | 100 | 25 | 214 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Signature (PPO) | 425 | 150 | 40 | 214 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Elite Choice (PPO) | 250 | 0 | 0 | 184 |

| Plan | In-network outpatient surgery | In-network advanced diagnostic imaging | Durable medical equipment | Part B administered drugs | Outpatient dialysis |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Value (HMO) | 20 | 20 | 20 | 20 | 20 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Essential (HMO) | 20 | 20 | 20 | 20 | 20 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Plus (HMO-POS) | 15 | 20 | 20 | 20 | 20 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Premier (PPO) | 20 | 25 | 20 | 20 | 20 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Signature (PPO) | 25 | 25 | 20 | 20 | 20 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Elite Choice (PPO) | 10 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 20 |

Each figure in the second table is a member coinsurance stated as a percentage of the plan allowed amount for that benefit category.

### Notes on the schedule

The acute inpatient figure from day 7 onward is 0 USD a day on the three HMO-form plans and on Ridgecrest Advantage Elite Choice (PPO); only Ridgecrest Advantage Premier (PPO) at 100 USD a day and Ridgecrest Advantage Signature (PPO) at 150 USD a day carry a figure from day 7. The same two plans are the only ones carrying a skilled nursing figure for days 1 to 20, at 25 and 40 USD a day. Outpatient dialysis stands at 20 per cent on every one of the six plans, and is the one coinsurance category that does not move with the plan held.
